Lessons: Who God Is: Trinity and Attributes; Creation and Providence; Humanity and the Fall; Christ and Atonement; Salvation and Justification; The Holy Spirit and Sanctification; The Church and Ordinances; Last Things and Christian Hope
Description: Big words like justification and sanctification become clear, friendly ideas in this grounding course. You will build a simple framework for what Christians believe and why it matters for worship, prayer and everyday life. No prior study needed — just curiosity.
KeyTopics: Trinity; Atonement; Justification; Sanctification; Holy Spirit; Church
